claims.statement: The anchor tenant at Northgate Business Park holds two successive five-year renewal options.

citations.quote: Tenant holds two successive five-year renewal options

claims.statement: The renewal options are exercisable at 95% of then-prevailing fair market rent.

citations.quote: exercisable at 95% of then-prevailing fair market rent

claims.statement: Exercise of the renewal options is conditioned on twelve months' prior written notice and the tenant not being in monetary default at the time of exercise.

citations.quote: conditioned on twelve months' prior written notice and tenant not being in monetary default at the time of exercise
